description: Re-scan a URL after you deployed fixes and report, per check id, whether it now passes (fixed: true), plus the new score, the previous score, what is still failing with its fix, and allFixed. Use this after a change reaches production (or a public preview) instead of asking the user to re-scan. Pass the check ids from the scan or fix prompt; with none, every failing or warning check is returned. If a fix you made still shows fixed: false, the deploy may not be live yet or a CDN may be serving a cached page: wait about a minute and call again before concluding the fix failed.

checks.description: Check ids to verify, e.g. ["og:image", "hsts"]. Optional.

url.description: The production or preview URL that was fixed.

name: verify_fixes
title: Verify fixes
